skeleton_and_submission_policy.controlled_target_skeletons: Each controlled Target.lean intentionally ends with a sorry placeholder so every agent receives the same theorem statement and an editable proof position. Those controlled skeletons compile with Lean's expected declaration-uses-sorry warning. Separately, six fresh private complete proofs, one for each task and condition, passed the final hidden validator without sorry.
skeleton_and_submission_policy.accepted_submission_rule: The placeholder is not allowed in an answer. Gold proofs and evaluated submissions must contain no sorry, admit, new axiom, unsafe checking bypass, forbidden import, or hidden gold dependency; the validator enforces these rules before accepting a proof.
skeleton_and_submission_policy.shared_statement_rule: All symbols in the three target statements come from Mathlib or the single shared Definitions.lean file. No target imports or names NumStability.

observational_limitations.one_paper_only: This release contains only P01, as requested. It cannot represent numerical analysis as a whole. Resampling whole papers with one paper repeats that same paper, so a 95% bootstrap range is degenerate and not informative.
observational_limitations.no_backend_seeds: rep-01, rep-02, and rep-03 are repetition IDs, not demonstrated fixed model seeds. The specification's paired fixed-seed rule is therefore not met, so measurements must be reported as an observational pilot and not as a reference HighamBench score.
observational_limitations.no_oci_image: There is no frozen OCI container image. Fresh bubblewrap namespaces and a hashed environment bundle are used instead. The read-only host system folders are not one completely fingerprinted filesystem, so this is a stated reference-protocol deviation.
observational_limitations.provider_connection: Model-accessible web and shell networking are disabled, but the Codex control process must keep its provider connection. This boundary must remain visible in the report.
observational_limitations.measurement_status: This review approves the task construction only. It does not claim that the planned 18-run measurement matrix has been executed or that any result is a protocol-compliant benchmark score.

reviewer_summary: All three fixed statements are faithful to the cited paper results, retain the assumptions needed by the formal models, compile in both conditions, and are not already stated as full declarations in Mathlib or the frozen NumStability baseline. T1 is deliberately a direct specialization of a stronger library result; T2 combines separate results; T3 needs a new no-guard accumulation. Approval is limited to task quality; the one-paper corpus, lack of backend seeds, and lack of a frozen OCI image require all measurements to remain clearly labeled as an observational pilot.
